# Security & Task Behavior Checklist: Taskify Kanban Platform

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of security, input-validation, task-card, and real-time/notification requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security Requirements Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Is the threat surface for the no-login phase documented, as the constitution requires per feature? [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [X] CHK002 Are the consequences of "identity selection is not a security boundary" stated for each action (create, assign, move, comment)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK003 Is the requirement for deny-by-default access reconciled with the spec's lack of any authentication? [Conflict, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-002]
- [X] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how the acting user is established and trusted between the web and API services? [Gap, Plan §Research D6]
- [X] CHK005 Are secret-handling requirements (service token, signing key) specified in the spec or plan? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [X] CHK006 Are the exit criteria for adding authentication in a later phase defined? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Input Validation Requirements Quality

- [X] CHK007 Are length limits stated for every free-text field (project name/description, task title/description, comment) in the spec rather than only in the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Data Model]
- [X] CHK008 Is "clear, non-technical message" for rejected input defined with required content (field, limit)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [X] CHK009 Are allowed values for status and role explicitly enumerated and is rejection of unknown values specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [X] CHK010 Are requirements defined for duplicate project names? [Gap, Data Model §Project]
- [X] CHK011 Is "plain text, never executed" defined for all output contexts (board, notifications, event stream)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK012 Are validation requirements specified for unknown or malformed identifiers (project, task, user)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK013 Are requirements stated for rejecting unexpected extra fields in requests? [Gap, Contract]

## Task Status Change Requirements

- [X] CHK014 Is ordering of cards within a column specified (initial order, order after a move, order for same-status moves)? [Gap, Data Model §Task.position]
- [X] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the outcome when a move fails (network or validation error) from the user's perspective? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [X] CHK016 Is "last move wins" conflict behavior measurable, including what the losing user sees? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK017 Is the keyboard-accessible alternative to dragging a card specified in the spec, not only in the plan? [Gap, Plan §Research D4]
- [X] CHK018 Are status-change audit requirements (who, when) consistent with FR-012 and the data model fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Assignment & Comment Requirements Quality

- [X] CHK019 Are the rules for unassigning and reassigning consistent across FR-007, the Task entity, and edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [X] CHK020 Is it specified whether the actor may assign a task to themselves and whether that creates a notification? [Gap, Data Model §Notification]
- [X] CHK021 Are comment requirements defined for ordering, maximum count, and display of long text? [Coverage, Spec §US4]
- [X] CHK022 Is the decision that comment editing and deletion are out of scope stated in scope boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Real-Time & Notification Requirements

- [X] CHK023 Are notification triggers and recipients in the spec, not only in the plan and data model? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK024 Is "update live without a refresh" quantified with a latency target in Success Criteria? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context]
- [X] CHK025 Are requirements defined for behavior when the live connection drops and recovers? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [X] CHK026 Are notification read/unread and retention requirements defined? [Gap]
- [X] CHK027 Is the notification rule for task comments (assignee plus earlier commenters) unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Data Model §Notification]
- [X] CHK028 Are acceptance scenarios present for notifications and live updates, given they were added after the original user stories? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional & Consistency

- [X] CHK029 Is the performance target of SC-006 ("no noticeable delay") quantified? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006]
- [X] CHK030 Are logging requirements specified for security-relevant events without recording sensitive content? [Gap, Constitution §Security Constraints]
- [X] CHK031 Is the API versioning and breaking-change policy stated for the service contract? [Completeness, Constitution §III]
- [X] CHK032 Do spec terminology ("column", "status") and API terminology stay consistent across documents? [Consistency]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
